name: dotnet-mutation-testing
description: Run Stryker.NET mutation testing on MSTest unit tests once before opening a pull request, limited to code changed against the base branch.

interface.longDescription: A skills-only plugin that runs Stryker.NET mutation testing against existing MSTest unit tests once before a pull request, limits mutation to changed code, stops when diff mode falls back to a full run, and summarizes surviving mutants.
defaultPrompt: Run mutation testing before I open this PR.
Which mutants survived in my changes?
Set up Stryker.NET for this MSTest project.
